top: My son, God will provide
bot: himself a lamb for a burnt offering...

top: In the beginning God created
bot: the heaven and the earth.

top: And Enoch walked with God:
bot: and he was not; for God took him.

top: I will not let thee go,
bot: except thou bless me.

top: And, behold, I am with thee,
bot: and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest...

top: And I am come down to deliver them
bot: out of the hand of the Egyptians...

top: Ye thought evil against me;
bot: but God meant it unto good...

top: The LORD is my strength and song,
bot: and he is become my salvation...

top: My presence shall go with thee,
bot: and I will give thee rest.

top: And he said,
bot: I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.

top: For I am the LORD your God...
bot: ye shall be holy; for I am holy...

top: For the life of the flesh is in the blood:
bot: ...it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.

top: The LORD bless thee,
bot: and keep thee.

top: ...and proclaim liberty throughout all the land
bot: unto all the inhabitants thereof...

top: ...every one that is bitten,
bot: when he looketh upon it, shall live.

top: ...man doth not live by bread only,
bot: but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD...

top: Be strong and of a good courage;
bot: ...the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

top: ...choose you this day whom ye will serve;
bot: ...as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.

top: ...and they shall be your refuge
bot: from the avenger of blood.

top: ...for man looketh on the outward appearance,
bot: but the LORD looketh on the heart.

top: If thou wilt redeem it, redeem it:
bot: ...And he said, I will redeem it.

top: Then Samuel answered,
bot: Speak; for thy servant heareth.

top: And thine house and thy kingdom
bot: shall be established for ever before thee...

top: ...for the battle is the LORD’s,
bot: and he will give you into our hands.

top: Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness
bot: ...and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.

top: Give therefore thy servant
bot: an understanding heart...

top: ...There is not a vessel more.
bot: And the oil stayed.

top: ...I pray thee, let a double portion
bot: of thy spirit be upon me.

top: Then the fire of the LORD fell,
bot: and consumed the burnt sacrifice...

top: ...and after the fire
bot: a still small voice.

top: I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears:
bot: behold, I will heal thee...

top: I have found the book of the law
bot: in the house of the LORD.

top: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good;
bot: for his mercy endureth for ever.

top: If my people... shall humble themselves, and pray,
bot: ...then will I hear from heaven... and will heal their land.

top: ...the LORD your God is gracious and merciful,
bot: and will not turn away his face from you, if ye return unto him.

top: ...neither be ye sorry;
bot: for the joy of the LORD is your strength.

top: The God of heaven, he will prosper us;
bot: therefore we his servants will arise and build...

top: ...who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom
bot: for such a time as this?

top: For I know that my redeemer liveth,
bot: and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth.

top: But he knoweth the way that I take:
bot: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

top: But his delight is in the law of the LORD;
bot: and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

top: The LORD is my shepherd;
bot: I shall not want.

top: Be still, and know that I am God:
bot: I will be exalted among the heathen...

top: The LORD is my light and my salvation;
bot: whom shall I fear?

top: O taste and see that the LORD is good:
bot: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

top: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean:
bot: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

top: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee:
bot: my soul thirsteth for thee...

top: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress:
bot: my God; in him will I trust.

top: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High
bot: shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

top: O come, let us worship and bow down:
bot: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.

top: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving,
bot: and into his courts with praise...

top: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet,
bot: and a light unto my path.

top: I will praise thee;
bot: for I am fearfully and wonderfully made...

top: Let every thing that hath breath
bot: praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.

top: In all thy ways acknowledge him,
bot: and he shall direct thy paths.

top: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold!
bot: and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!

top: The name of the LORD is a strong tower:
bot: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

top: To every thing there is a season,
bot: and a time to every purpose under the heaven.

top: Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?
bot: Then said I, Here am I; send me.

top: Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son,
bot: and shall call his name Immanuel.

top: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD:
bot: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow...

top: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace,
bot: whose mind is stayed on thee...

top: ...and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor,
bot: The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.

top: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength;
bot: they shall mount up with wings as eagles...

top: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people,
bot: saith your God.

top: Fear not: for I have redeemed thee,
bot: I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.

top: But he was wounded for our transgressions,
bot: ...and with his stripes we are healed.

top: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters...
bot: ...come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

top: Arise, shine; for thy light is come,
bot: and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.

top: And ye shall seek me, and find me,
bot: when ye shall search for me with all your heart.

top: Behold, as the clay is in the potter’s hand,
bot: so are ye in mine hand...

top: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth...
bot: ...there is nothing too hard for thee.

top: ...his compassions fail not.
bot: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

top: Call unto me, and I will answer thee,
bot: and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.

top: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth...
bot: ...wherefore turn yourselves, and live ye.

top: ...and I will put a new spirit within you;
bot: and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh...

top: And I sought for a man among them,
bot: that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap...

top: Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep,
bot: and seek them out.

top: ...whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live:
bot: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish...

top: ...but they could find none occasion nor fault;
bot: forasmuch as he was faithful...

top: And I will restore to you
bot: the years that the locust hath eaten...

top: Now the LORD had prepared a great fish
bot: to swallow up Jonah.

top: ...I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh;
bot: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy...

top: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity...
bot: ...he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.

top: Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables,
bot: that he may run that readeth it.

top: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save,
bot: he will rejoice over thee with joy...

top: And he saith unto them, Follow me,
bot: and I will make you fishers of men.

top: ...behold, thy King cometh unto thee:
bot: he is just, and having salvation; lowly...

top: Give us this day
bot: our daily bread.

top: Let your light so shine before men,
bot: that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father...

top: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations,
bot: baptizing them in the name of the Father...

top: ...If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed...
bot: ...nothing shall be impossible unto you.

top: ...and upon this rock I will build my church;
bot: and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.

top: Launch out into the deep,
bot: and let down your nets for a draught.

top: For unto you is born this day in the city of David
bot: a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

top: If thou canst believe,
bot: all things are possible to him that believeth.

top: If the Son therefore shall make you free,
bot: ye shall be free indeed.

top: For this my son was dead, and is alive again;
bot: he was lost, and is found.

top: Verily, verily, I say unto thee,
bot: Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

top: ...whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him
bot: shall never thirst...

top: Abide in me, and I in you.
bot: As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine...

top: ...he said, It is finished:
bot: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.

top: Cast the net on the right side of the ship,
bot: and ye shall find.

top: I am the way, the truth, and the life:
bot: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

top: But ye shall receive power,
bot: after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you...

top: For the wages of sin is death;
bot: but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

top: Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ,
bot: and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.

top: But where sin abounded,
bot: grace did much more abound.

top: And be not conformed to this world:
bot: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind...

top: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus,
bot: ...thou shalt be saved.

top: And we know that all things work together for good
bot: to them that love God...

top: My grace is sufficient for thee:
bot: for my strength is made perfect in weakness.

top: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory
bot: through our Lord Jesus Christ.

top: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace,
bot: longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith...

top: For by grace are ye saved through faith;
bot: and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God.

top: Rejoice in the Lord alway:
bot: and again I say, Rejoice.

top: I press toward the mark for the prize
bot: of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

top: Put on the whole armour of God,
bot: that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

top: For the word of God is quick, and powerful,
bot: and sharper than any twoedged sword...

top: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace,
bot: that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

top: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course,
bot: I have kept the faith.

top: ...and let us run with patience
bot: the race that is set before us.

top: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for,
bot: the evidence of things not seen.

top: Casting all your care upon him;
bot: for he careth for you.

top: Surely I come quickly. Amen.
bot: Even so, come, Lord Jesus.

top: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock:
bot: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in...

top: And whosoever will,
bot: let him take the water of life freely.

top: Worthy is the Lamb that was slain
bot: to receive power, and riches, and wisdom...

top: Lord, thou knowest all things;
bot: thou knowest that I love thee... Feed my sheep.
